scenario_data.body: Epilogue 2
The days after Aoi leaves for the island fly by.
And I go to visit her whenever I can find the time.
We are handling our long distance relationship just fine.
And in the spring...
*Woosh.*

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Whew... We're nearly to Aoi's island..."
I lean out over the deck.
The island coming into view is now a familiar sight for me.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (The thought of seeing Aoi makes the 10 hour trip seem like nothing at all.)

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Wait for me, Aoi...!)
A few hours later I arrive on the island.
I am taking the usual road up to Aoi's school, when...

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Okay! Next runners get ready!"
I can see the school grounds where the track team are practicing.
And of course Miss Aoi Mizusawa is in charge.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Hm. Aikawa, you should try raising your knees a bit more when you run!"

scenario_data.speaker: Student
scenario_data.body: "Okay! I'll try!"

scenario_data.speaker: Student
scenario_data.body: "What about me, Miss?"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Ah, Ito! You beat your best time, didn't you?"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "I can see you have been working at your sprint practice. Well done!"

scenario_data.speaker: Student
scenario_data.body: "Ehehe!"

scenario_data.speaker: Student
scenario_data.body: "Oh, that's right! Thank you for the other day, Miss!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Thank you? For what...?"

scenario_data.speaker: Student
scenario_data.body: "That thing you taught us about how to sleep in class without being caught..."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "E-Endo!! Ssh! Don't say that where people can hear you...!"
I can hear the students' excited babble all the way from over here.
It warms my heart to see it.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Ahaha...! It looks like Miss Aoi is hard at work...)
Then...
It appears that Aoi has spotted me where I stand just beyond the school grounds.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "William!!"
"She beams with her entire face as she sprints over to... Wha!?"
*Dash!*

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "W-w-w-wait!?"
I immediately turn about face and run.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Why are you running away, William!?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Because you came charging at me like a wild boar!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "That's mean! I'm just happy to see you!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Have you forgotten the first time I came here!?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "You ran at me just I like you did now and knocked me down so hard I blacked out!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Ahaha! Yes, I remember that happening."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "It's no laughing matter!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "And I'm telling you, you can't act like this while at school!"
She chases me across the grounds. Behind us I can hear her students voices.

scenario_data.speaker: Student
scenario_data.body: "Ah. It's Miss Mizusawa'a boyfriend."

scenario_data.speaker: Student
scenario_data.body: "She always flies off to meet him like that the moment he arrives."

scenario_data.speaker: Student
scenario_data.body: "Apparently that's how adults show their affection."

scenario_data.speaker: Student
scenario_data.body: "Oh? I need a boyfriend I can try it on.!"
What on earth is she teaching these kids!?

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Gotcha, William!"
*Nom!*

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "W-w-whaaa!?"
It soon turns to evening.
Aoi and I go back to her place together after the excitement at the school grounds.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "And after all that you knocked me down yet again..."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Ahaha. Sorry."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "I was just so happy to see you."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Honestly..."
There's no point in dwelling on it... Time to change the subject.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "You seem to have settled in as a teacher now."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Yes! Kind of."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "And you've found a job back there, haven't you?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Yes, well... I'm working on it."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Haha, I see."
She suddenly looks unusually serious.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "I've gotten used to my job as a teacher, but..."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "I have to leave this school soon..."
We arrive back at Aoi's apartment.
She looks up at her current home, and whispers.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "William..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Hm?"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Thank you for coming today..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "As if I wouldn't come..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Today is an important day for us both."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Yeah..."
It's nearly been a full year since Aoi came to work as a teacher on this island.
And it is the day the results for her second attempt at the teaching license exam are out.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (Today she finds out if she passed, and whether or not she can continue as a fully-fledged teacher.)
With anxiousness written on both our faces, we enter the apartment.
We check her mail, and see that she has one letter.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "It's your results, isn't it?"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Y-yeah..."
Her hands shake slightly as she picks it up.
And then returns to her room with me.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "O-okay... I'm going to open my results now..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Okay..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (I'm feeling nervous too...!)
But Aoi is several times more nervous,and scared, than I am.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: (I guess she can't help remembering one year ago when she failed...)
Since she looks worried I put an arm around her shoulders.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "William...!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Let's take a look then?"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Y-yeah...!"
Aoi opens the envelope up slowly.
She takes out the paper from inside and opens it with shaking hands.
Her results are...!

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "... I passed...!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "And it says that I have my first posting in Tokyo...!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "We can live together again, can't we!?"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Ah... Yeah!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi & Mihile
scenario_data.body: "Yahoo~!!"
We both scream in delight.
Aoi wraps her arms around me, her eyes shining.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "You did it, Aoi!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "I did! I did...!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "I'm so glad... Truly...!"
I feel a lot of affection for her in that moment, and I embrace her in return.
She holds me tight around my waist.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "We'll always be together now, William...!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Yeah!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Don't ever be apart from me again."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Never...!"
But then I remember something, and whisper to her.

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "It's nearly time to say goodbye to the school here on the island..."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Yeah..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Are you Sad?"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "I am, but I'll be fine..."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "I'll work hard teaching track and field right up to the end, and say goodbye with a smile!"

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "I see..."
It is a very Aoi-like thing to say.
Aoi laughs happily, her face glowing red.

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Ehehe..."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "I can finally go home to you..."

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Yeah!"

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "Hm?"
She looks at me curiously.
I look straight into her eyes, and say...

scenario_data.speaker: William
scenario_data.body: "Welcome home."

scenario_data.speaker: Aoi
scenario_data.body: "It's good to have a home to come back to..."
We stare into one another's eyes, and smile.
Our faces gravitate closer together and I can feel her breath on my skin...
We share a tender kiss.
A kiss that speaks of an everlasting love.
